_readme: A body = up to 6 lanes. Each lane is ONE physical object with two poses:
LOW (Morph 0) and HIGH (Morph 100). A pose = a pole [Hz, radius] and a
zero [Hz, radius]. MORPH slides each lane between its poses. Q tightens
the pole by q_tighten (0 = none, 0.02 = normal, 0.06 = strong bloom).
The zero's JOB relative to its pole (tonight's grammar):
zero ON the pole (same Hz, radius ~0.94-0.96)  -> parked pad / gentle color
zero JUST BELOW the pole                        -> razor edge (Lucifers comb)
zero FAR from the pole                          -> real notch / shelf work
Radii: poles 0.85-0.99 (violence is MOTION, not hot poles). Gain is
handled for you (each lane normalized flat off-resonance).
'source' is REQUIRED per lane: cite the table/measurement the Hz came
family_intents.json, DVTD/HRTF rails...). Invented Hz = the tool refuses.
A lane you don't need: {"parked": true}.
Compile + verdict sheets:  python tools/author_sheet.py sheets/<this>.json
Outputs land in dev/tmp/author_sheet/ — same sheet format as the ROM study.
name: MY_BODY_NAME

lanes.what: example: F1 formant with its antiresonance
lanes.source: CITE THE TABLE OR MEASUREMENT HERE — empty gets refused

lanes.what: example: the canyon — a true unit-circle notch that travels
lanes.source: CITE — e.g. geometric mean of the table's F2/F3
